enriched_description: Vertical or horizontal rectangular housing containing three or two circular signal lenses arranged in sequence (red, amber, green). The housing is constructed from dark gray or black painted metal or polycarbonate with a matte finish. Each lens measures approximately 20-30 cm in diameter with a colored transparent cover and an internal reflector. A visor or hood extends over each lens to reduce glare. The unit is mounted on a vertical pole or suspended wire with visible mounting brackets. Standard dimensions approximately 100-120 cm tall for vertical configuration.

Folded paper cover wrapping around a hardcover book, featuring full-color printed artwork on the front panel, spine text, and promotional blurbs on the back. The dust jacket exhibits glossy or matte lamination with crisp fold lines at the spine edges. Inner flaps contain author biography and pricing information. Dimensions match the book's height and width with extended flap sections. Surface displays vibrant CMYK printing with photographic or illustrated cover art and bold typography.

Printed or digital listing of available food and beverage items organized by category (appetizers, entrees, desserts, beverages). The physical menu appears as a folded card, booklet, or single sheet with structured typography, item names, descriptions, and prices. Layout features clear hierarchical headings, consistent font styling, and occasional decorative borders or restaurant branding. Paper stock ranges from thin cardstock to laminated durable material. Color scheme reflects restaurant theme and ambiance.

Round flat ceramic dish with a slightly raised rim, typically 23-28 cm in diameter. The surface exhibits a smooth glossy glaze in white or off-white coloration with subtle concentric ring patterns from the manufacturing process. The plate features a shallow central well for food containment and a flat outer rim. Edge profile shows a gentle upward curve. Surface is reflective with light-scattering properties characteristic of vitreous ceramic.

Thick green dip with coarse mashed texture, exhibiting vibrant avocado green coloration with visible flecks of chopped onion, cilantro, tomato, and jalapeño. The surface shows an uneven, chunky consistency with slight oil sheen from the avocado fat. Served in a bowl, the dip displays a mounded profile with visible ingredient particulates. Color ranges from bright lime green to deeper olive depending on avocado ripeness and oxidation level.

Crystal-clear amber or golden-brown broth served in a shallow bowl, exhibiting complete transparency with no visible particulates or cloudiness. The liquid surface shows a slight oily sheen with subtle light refraction. Color ranges from pale gold (chicken) to deep mahogany (beef) depending on the base stock. The soup is presented at serving temperature with visible steam rising. Garnish may include fine julienne vegetables or herbs floating on the surface.

Hearty stew served in a deep ceramic or cast-iron pot with a tight-fitting lid. The contents exhibit a thick, rich brown gravy coating chunks of tender meat (beef, lamb, or chicken) and cubed potatoes. Surface shows a glossy sheen from rendered fat with visible herbs and vegetables. The stew has a dense, chunky texture with irregular ingredient shapes. Steam rises from the hot surface, and the pot exterior may show condensation or heat discoloration.

Layered cold dessert served in a clear glass bowl, exhibiting distinct horizontal strata of golden sponge cake, colorful fruit preserves or fresh berries, creamy custard, and whipped cream topping. The visible side profile shows alternating light and dark bands. Top surface is decorated with piped cream rosettes, scattered nuts, chocolate shavings, or fresh fruit. The dessert has a tall cylindrical profile with translucent glass revealing the layered interior structure.

Frozen dairy dessert with smooth, creamy texture served in scoops or a container. The surface exhibits a slightly glossy finish with visible air cell structure creating a soft, pliable appearance. Color varies by flavor (white for vanilla, brown for chocolate, pink for strawberry). Scoops display a rounded dome shape with slight surface melting at room temperature. The texture shows characteristic scoop marks and a dense, rich consistency with slight crystalline structure visible at close range.

Frozen confection on a flat wooden stick, exhibiting a molded elongated oval shape with rounded top and flat bottom where the stick is embedded. The surface is smooth and glossy with vibrant translucent or opaque coloration (red, orange, green, or multi-layered). The popsicle shows slight condensation droplets on the surface from ambient temperature exposure. Dimensions approximately 12-15 cm total length with the stick protruding 5-6 cm. Surface may show subtle mold seam lines from manufacturing.
